verdict: Cost per lead hit a new low, but ads went dark Sep 9–10.
narrative: In the last 28 days you received 30 leads from Meta at an average cost per lead of $46.95 — and that number is improving fast, dropping 50% week-over-week as campaign efficiency tightened. That progress was interrupted on September 9–10, when Meta delivered zero spend and zero leads on both days; delivery has since resumed and we are confirming the root cause. On the intake side, 6 of your 30 leads are not yet reflected in the contact system, and no opportunities have been logged against any of them — we are closing that gap so your pipeline accurately reflects what the ads are producing. Next week's priority is keeping delivery stable and ensuring every inbound lead moves into a trackable intake stage.
